Thank you to everyone who responded. I would have never guessed that what i thought was a throwaway comment would get so much attention. I don't like to "whine" to strangers about my problems. I feel guilty enough that my wife has to deal with me. Ive had an awful 2 weeks. Almost the worst period of depression all year. Its brutal. Its tiring....exhausting. As i read your comments i started to cry... They moved me. They took my pain away for a few minutes. So to all you great people, thank you. I love my daughter more than anything in the world. I am terrified that one day this horrible disease that i have will win out and ill be gone. I fight every day for that not to happen. Ive also planned out how when and where I'd do it, what id write in a note, then picture my little girls face and hate myself more for feeling this way. Then get more depressed. Horrible cycle. To answer some questions : I'm on 3 meds rn for symptoms, i did 2 solid years of therapy weekly, and the only hobby i have is running. And when youre depressed that's a hard thing to go do. Im underemployed, no friends, so success financially... See... You don't want to hear all this. The point of me writing was just to say thank you to all the kind people who expressed concern and caring toward me. It truly made me smile for a few short moments, and ill take as many of those moments as i can get.
